about_the_game:
In a world where even the bravest adventurers fear the forest, a girl named Fany decides to face the impossible. Alongside her loyal fairy companion, she embarks on a magical journey through forgotten lands filled with danger, secrets, and mystical creatures.

Retorno Nando is a 2D platformer focused on action and exploration, where you control Fany through a challenge-packed adventure. The game blends simple combat, precise jumping, gem collection, and memorable boss fights.

Key Features:

  • 🎮 Platformer gameplay with action elements

  • 🧩 10 handcrafted levels, each with unique traps and enemies

  • ✨ Collect diamonds and use points to improve your abilities

  • 🧚 Fairy companion helps with tips and story moments

  • 👹 Epic bosses that test your reflexes and timing

  • 🎵 Immersive soundtrack and charming retro visuals

  • ⌛ Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours, depending on skill

Driven by curiosity and a desire to prove herself, Fany doesn't run from the unknown — she runs toward it.

Get ready for a magical adventure full of action, growth, and surprises in a whimsical, unpredictable world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for a better experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 or better
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for a better experience

short_description: A magical 2D action-adventure game. Join Fany on a journey through mysterious forests, overcome challenges, face mystical creatures, and uncover forgotten secrets in a charming and magical world.
